description: Two teams, one rope: every right answer pulls the flag your way. Pick your grade from 1 to 8 so the questions fit, from adding within 20 to equations. Take on the computer on Easy, Normal or Hard, or tug a friend on one screen with a keypad each. Or host it live: the class splits into two teams and everyone answers on their own device.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit (pinned kit 1.1.3 tag plus the art-animals and dress packs): the kit's title, countdown, pause (P / Esc / the pause button), settings (sound, less motion), results card, font, icons and light/dark look. Before every game a setup card: grade 1-8 (decides the kinds of questions, with sample questions on the card), players (vs Computer or 2 players on one screen), the computer's level (Easy / Normal / Hard) and time (60 s, 90 s, 2 min, or first to the line, capped at 3 min); the last choice is remembered in BRB.storage key 'tug-of-math-v1' (ids only, plus the best right-answer count per grade and level). Questions come from window.TugGen (pure ES5 between /* tug-gen:begin */ and /* tug-gen:end */; server/live/tug-gen.js runs the same block for Oomba Live): whole-number answers only; G1 add/subtract within 20 and missing addends, G2 within 100, G3 times and division facts to 10 x 10 and add/subtract within 1000, G4 multi-digit x 1-digit, exact division and two-step, G5 2-digit x 2-digit, bigger division and simple order of operations, G6 order of operations, easy percents and squares, G7 integers with negatives and one-step equations, G8 two-step equations, powers and square roots. The minus key shows only for grades 7-8. Both sides' n-th questions are the same kind (a shared seed), never the same question twice in a row. The computer (window.TugBot, between /* tug-bot:begin */ and /* tug-bot:end */): Easy about 9 s per answer and 65% right, Normal 5 s and 82%, Hard 2.6 s and 94%, times scaled by how hard the question is; a slow 2nd grader beats Easy (unit-tested). Each right answer pulls the rope one step; past the line (8 steps, 6 in 'to the line') wins at once, else the most pulls when time runs out (equal is a draw). Layout: landscape (smartboard, tablet, desktop, phone on its side) is Blue | tug | Red with a keypad each; portrait stacks them, Red's half turned round for two players or a small computer card for vs Computer. Keypads take every finger at once (pointer events), and the keyboard: digits, Backspace, Enter and '-' (two players: Blue on the number row, Red on the number pad). The field stays Blue-left in right-to-left languages; maths is always left to right. All words in 13 languages (the I18N block). vs Computer submits BRB.gameOver({won, score: right answers}); two players submit nothing. No poll, no network, no text input. window.__brbTest: state/setup/start({grade, mode, diff, len, seed})/answer(side, n)/solve(side)/press(side, key)/setTime(s)/skipAnimations/gen(grade, n)/unlock. Oomba Live (built-in mode 'tug', docs/live-protocol.md "Tug of Math"): the same file draws the live view when Oomba.live.active (the kit live pack is loaded): the host picks the grade and length on /live, the platform splits the class into Blue Whales and Red Foxes, the server sends each player their own questions (event tq), checks every answer (ans -> tr) and moves the rope by team averages (shared state tug); the projector shows both teams, the clock and the big tug, a phone its team, a small rope, its question and the keypad.

es.description: Dos equipos, una cuerda: cada respuesta correcta tira de la bandera hacia tu lado. Elige tu curso, del 1 al 8, para que las preguntas encajen, desde sumas hasta 20 hasta ecuaciones. Juega contra la compu en Fácil, Normal o Difícil, o contra un amigo en la misma pantalla, cada uno con su teclado. O juégalo en vivo: la clase se divide en dos equipos y cada uno responde en su propio dispositivo.

de.description: Zwei Teams, ein Seil: Jede richtige Antwort zieht die Fahne zu dir. Wähle deine Klasse von 1 bis 8, damit die Aufgaben passen, vom Plus bis 20 bis zu Gleichungen. Spiel gegen den Computer auf Leicht, Mittel oder Schwer oder zu zweit an einem Bildschirm, jeder mit seinem Tastenfeld. Oder live spielen: Die Klasse teilt sich in zwei Teams, und alle antworten auf ihrem eigenen Gerät.

it.description: Due squadre, una corda: ogni risposta giusta tira la bandiera dalla tua parte. Scegli la tua classe, dalla 1 alla 8, per domande su misura, dalle addizioni entro il 20 alle equazioni. Sfida il computer in Facile, Normale o Difficile, o un amico sullo stesso schermo, ognuno con il suo tastierino. Oppure dal vivo: la classe si divide in due squadre e ognuno risponde dal proprio dispositivo.

pt.description: Dois times, uma corda: cada resposta certa puxa a bandeira para o seu lado. Escolha seu ano, do 1º ao 8º, para as perguntas combinarem com você, de somas até 20 a equações. Enfrente o computador no Fácil, Normal ou Difícil, ou um amigo na mesma tela, cada um com seu teclado. Ou jogue ao vivo: a turma se divide em dois times e cada um responde no próprio aparelho.

nl.description: Twee teams, één touw: elk goed antwoord trekt de vlag naar jouw kant. Kies je groep, van groep 3 tot klas 2, zodat de vragen passen, van optellen tot 20 tot vergelijkingen. Speel tegen de computer op Makkelijk, Normaal of Moeilijk, of met een vriend op één scherm, ieder met een eigen toetsenblok. Of speel het live: de klas wordt verdeeld in twee teams en iedereen antwoordt op een eigen apparaat.

ru.description: Две команды, один канат: каждый верный ответ тянет флажок на твою сторону. Выбери свой класс, с 1 по 8, чтобы задачи были по силам: от сложения в пределах 20 до уравнений. Сражайся с компьютером на уровнях «Легко», «Средне» или «Сложно» или с другом на одном экране, у каждого своя клавиатура. Или вживую: класс делится на две команды, и каждый отвечает на своём устройстве.

he.description: שתי קבוצות, חבל אחד: כל תשובה נכונה מושכת את הדגל לצד שלכם. בחרו כיתה מא׳ עד ח׳ כדי שהשאלות יתאימו, מחיבור עד 20 ועד משוואות. שחקו נגד המחשב ברמה קל, רגיל או קשה, או נגד חבר על אותו מסך, לכל אחד לוח מקשים משלו. או בשידור חי: הכיתה מתחלקת לשתי קבוצות וכל אחד עונה במכשיר שלו.
